reason: A browser-based acceptance testing tool for agent-built web applications, using JSON specifications to execute deterministic checks and produce pass/fail reports with visual evidence.

summaries.zh: 用于在真实浏览器中对智能体构建的网页应用执行可复现验收测试，并生成包含截图证据的通过或失败报告。
summaries.en: Runs reproducible acceptance tests for agent-built web applications in real browsers and generates pass/fail reports with screenshot evidence.

capabilities: Executes browser-based acceptance checks against local or remote web applications
Performs configured browser interactions such as navigation, clicks, and form input
Checks text, classes, computed styles, URLs, console errors, network errors, and screenshots
Produces pass/fail reports with screenshots and pixel-diff images
Exposes verification functions through a CLI and MCP server
